0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>This well-meaning mentor would ask for your help with unfinished business.

24.original: Survey the designated areas and slay the anemone should it appear.

25.original: Deliver the anemone corpse to the well-meaning mentor.

48.original: Your travels have led you back to Slitherbough, I see. Your timing is fortuitous. Preparations for the anemone hunt are complete. If you are of a mind to join me, your aid would be most appreciated.

49.original: It was last seen in the southwestern region of Cleric. The hunt will prove difficult, however, as that is where the Children chose to build their spiders' nest.

50.original: Tread lightly, and do not hesitate to strike it down on sight. I only ask that you retrieve its corpse should you find it first.

51.original: You see no sign of the anemone. Perhaps you should search elsewhere.

52.original: You find the corpse of an animal, but there are no signs of a struggle. Perhaps it was killed with poison...

53.original: You are returned. I hope you had better luck than I.

55.original: <sigh> Would that there was another way, but the threat it posed to the Greatwood could not be ignored.

56.original: Mark my words: this <hex:021A020203>will not<hex:021A020103> happen again.
